body:
## Pull request overview

Fixes a Next.js SSR prerender failure by preventing `@object-ui/fields`’ Vite/Rollup build from bundling `@object-ui/i18n` (and its CJS transitive deps like `react-i18next`), which can trigger `"dynamic usage of require is not supported"` during SSR.

**Changes:**
- Updated `@object-ui/fields` Vite config to use a regex-based `rollupOptions.external` function and to externalize `@object-ui/i18n` (including subpath imports).
- Documented the SSR build fix in the root `CHANGELOG.md`.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 2 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/fields/vite.config.ts | Switches Rollup externals to a regex matcher and adds `@object-ui/i18n` to prevent bundling SSR-incompatible CJS transitive deps. |
| CHANGELOG.md | Adds an Unreleased “Fixed” entry describing the fields SSR build externalization change and the resulting SSR error fix. |
